notes.title: Removal
notes.notes:
This weekend or next Monday I have decided to remove Dojini from the steam store.
All those who have activated keys or purchased the game will still be able to play it, it just will not be on the store, from this weekend.
I am removing the game due to personal reasons.
EDIT- It will actually removed August 26th

notes.title: Dojini Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33320188/8d3d3af2235f7fc34d5b95a40308c74b187e8b4b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33320188/9cce4267490cd5f6a0288938968447922d730aa4.png[/img][/url]
Some changes have been made to Dojini to make it play more smoothly

[list]
[*] A graphics option has been added so you can control the graphics quality of the game so it can suit your computer.
[*] You change the resolution of the game so it suits your needs
[*] You can turn the Audio on and of in the game
[*] Levels now loop music so you don't hear the start of song if you die
[*] A new coverart image has been made
[*] Some minor changes to some levels has been made.
[/list]

notes.title: Mini Update
notes.notes:
A few updates have been made to the game
To make more casual

Updates:

[*]  A controls menu page has been added so you can see the controls for keyboard and controller for the game.
[*] Levels have been made easier
[*] Enemies hit boxes have been reduced
[*] Before no enemies could be killed now certain enemies detailed in the game can be killed if you jump on there head


This should make the game more casual and fun to play
